summary: RG-3 Plugin consumer package: implement the new alembic_plan MCP tool (draft/confirm/get) on top of the accepted Core Plan ledger/projection foundation at AlembicCore commit dd4db2c. This completes the C Plan-center tool surface without advancing RG-4 generation gates.

targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg3-plugin-alembic-plan-tool-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-1 and RG-2 Core signal/planning aids are accepted, and RG-3 Core Plan ledger/projection is accepted at AlembicCore commit dd4db2c59cea3cf8c3363b4927683c9cccd45a87 with public @alembic/core/plans facade, plans intent table, PlanRepository, PlanLedgerService, draft information package, generation-state projection, and projectContextSignature helpers. Goal: implement the Plugin-side alembic_plan MCP tool as the new planning surface with operations draft/confirm/get, consuming Core rather than inventing parallel state. Required behavior: (1) register/expose alembic_plan as the new MCP tool using existing Plugin tool registration/output/error conventions, while preserving existing four-tool MCP semantics; (2) draft: collect real information from ProjectContext/MissionBriefing/OnboardingContract/DimensionTask-style existing Plugin/Core flows plus RG-1/RG-2 architecture/dimension planning/dynamic signals where available, built-in SOP/domain/tool menu context, and optional hints; build a deterministic information package/planningBrief via Core helpers; persist a pending/draft Plan intent through Core PlanRepository/PlanLedgerService; return enough structured data for the host Agent to decide dimensions/scale/tools without Plugin guessing; (3) confirm: accept an Agent decision payload modeled on HostAgentDimensionCompleteArgs/selectedDimensions plus scale/budget, module bindings or plannedNextActions, basePlanId/version, projectContextSignature and rationale; validate it against the draft/base version enough to avoid confirming stale or mismatched plans; persist active confirmed intent through Core; return planId/version/status/signature and a merged Plan view or stable pointer as appropriate; (4) get: return the active confirmed Plan for the project as intent + read-time generation-state projection from Core, including codeRecipeMapping/coverage/gaps/proposals/changeLog/signature comparison when available; (5) ensure Plan state is stored only through Core plans intent persistence and projected state, not a separate Plugin JSON/state store or generation-state double write; (6) add tests proving draft uses real ProjectContext/RG-2-style signals rather than language-only guessing, confirm stores intent and handles stale base/signature mismatch, get returns the merged Core projection, and existing four tools keep their current semantics; (7) document or encode the tool's output contract consistently with Plugin conventions if this repository has a local tool schema registry. Boundaries: do not implement RG-4 bootstrap/rescan/deep-mining/module-mining hard gates, three-stage Recipe generation, create-time ProjectContext anchor, vector isolation/isAvailable, timing fixes, commit-driven unified evolution, Test/BiliDili scenario, daemon/watch behavior, or deletion of evidence/proposal/vector structures. Do not create a type-only shell, static mock, separate Plugin-only Plan store, or heuristic language-only planner. If the full Plugin RG-3 slice is too large for one target turn, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest executable split and raw evidence; otherwise complete with commit hash, changed files, evidence refs, validation output, risks, and next-step notes. Expected validation: build/typecheck for Plugin; targeted tests for alembic_plan draft/confirm/get and tool registration/output contract; existing MCP/public tool registry tests or smoke tests touched by adding a tool; tests or probes proving existing four-tool semantics are unchanged; lint/test/build when feasible; git diff --check.
